title: Graph revision test fixture extraction
description: Objective: bring the graph-revision test below the permanent file-size cap without changing its coverage. Deliverable: new packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-test-fixtures.ts owns deterministic hashes, witnesses, state/command builders, and exact-error helpers; graph-revision-reducer.test.ts retains every existing test and assertion and is <=250 lines. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6. NOT in scope: production edits, new validation rules, renamed/skipped tests, or assertion weakening. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-reducer.test.ts and packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-test-fixtures.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: All existing graph-revision test names and assertions remain in graph-revision-reducer.test.ts and execute exactly once.
The fixture module is deterministic, has no shared mutable state, and exports test-only helpers without changing production exports.
Both files are <=250 physical lines with no skip/only/todo or weakened checks.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.

Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.

implementationPlan.description: Characterization baseline (read-only): graph-revision-reducer.test.ts is 288 lines / 18 it() cases; fixture surface = lines 17-93 (hash(), GRAPH_HASH..STALE_HASH constants, BINDING/SUBMISSION/APPROVAL/ACTIVATION/REJECTION witnesses, BOUND, state(), commandFor(), expectError(), expectIllegal(), accepted() — ~77 lines) — extracting it brings the test to ~215 lines, comfortably <=250, with ALL 18 cases STAYING in the test file (no second test file; DoD 1 demands every name remain HERE and execute exactly once). Record the it()-name baseline list to a scratchpad file OUTSIDE the repo. Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test` GREEN before starting (shared tree — attribute foreign red by path).

Extract packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-test-fixtures.ts BY RANGE: move lines 17-93 verbatim with exactly their current imports (RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES if used by the moved code, expect from vitest for the assertion helpers — legal test infrastructure: the module is *.ts non-.test so the root vitest include never collects it as a suite, it is only imported FROM the test; contract types via `import type` from './graph-revision-contract.js'); export every moved symbol; NodeNext '.js' specifiers; prune the test file's now-unused imports (noUnusedLocals) and import the fixtures via './graph-revision-test-fixtures.js'. RAIL CHECK: deterministic only (hash() is seed-based; no Date/random), no shared mutable state (frozen consts + pure factories), exports nothing production-shaped (zero overlap with packages/core/src/index.ts exports — DoD 2). Test file body: ZERO case edits, zero renames, zero skip/only/todo.

Verification gate + audit: (1) `wc -l` both files — each <=250 physical lines (expect ~215 test / ~85 fixtures); (2) case audit — `grep -c "it("` in the test file === 18 AND the sorted it()-name list equals the step-1 baseline exactly (loops over BOUND move with derivation intact — derived names must match too); grep skip|only|todo -> zero; (3) fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test` -> exit 0 with production files untouched (`git status --porcelain -- packages/core/src/planning` shows only the two owned paths) — complete_task evidence: { command: "pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test", exitCode: 0, outputTail }; assertions pass count unchanged vs baseline; (4) isolation run of the test file alone -> green; repo gate with foreign-red attribution; run twice — identical.

Adversarial self-review + explicit-pathspec commit. Load Skill adversarial-self-review. Extra: (a) verbatim-move diff of every fixture body against `git show HEAD:packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-reducer.test.ts` — identical (witness truth classes, hash seeds, BOUND membership untouched); (b) fixtures export-overlap grep vs core index exports -> zero; (c) scratchpad baseline lives outside the repo — confirm no strays (auto-commit sweep); (d) no `let`/mutation in fixtures. Commit per epic rail 3: `git status --porcelain`, unstage foreign paths, `git add` + `git commit -- packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-reducer.test.ts packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-test-fixtures.ts`; `git show --stat` lists exactly these 2 paths.
